title_short: Valerie Stewart · The One Thing They Ask
headline: Parents leaving a shelter ask Valerie for one thing: shoes. So she comes back every year, and brings her co-workers.
story: Valerie Stewart works at RS Eden, a housing program for parents who leave homelessness. They arrive with almost nothing. The one thing they always ask her for is shoes, hats, gloves and a coat.
So she volunteers to see the kids smile. This is her third year. She brought a new co-worker, who left saying “I'll be back next year.” Warm and positive. No pity.
